centeredFallback: Two explicit 2x2 synthetic blockers beside the stage force a centered entry in an otherwise actual room-floor/bed geometry. Both preferredFacing signs were checked.
geometryCheck: Approach uses all furniture including target; entry and reversed exit ignore only target. Each segment also independently unions rectangle endpoints and swept four edges with CoreGraphics boolean geometry, subtracts floor and intersects all remaining obstacles.
guardedBoundary: When a narrow/tall room makes the mattress edge higher than 0.55 cat widths, restVisit returns nil before creating a plan or deformation. RoomScene requestRest maps this nil to rest.blocked for a notified user request. The six normal phone canvases retain safe reachability. This is an intentional step-height boundary; no contact is fabricated.
independentSupportCheck: The front paw is reconstructed from the original cat-step PNG alpha crop, frame2 source paw landmark, source ground registration, and Float32 bilinear interpolation of the 8x8 rendered warp. Its world point is then mapped into the independent bed PNG alpha crop. The held point is at original source row805.11; actual rounded contact pixels are opaque and above the first green vertical-side pixel in their column. This is additional to rectangle-band distance, not a restatement of the elevation equation.
scope: Pure Swift core geometry plus source-image and mesh arithmetic. No SpriteKit render, simulator, Xcode project build, or device test.
